facts.t: Inside the black hole her fingers come away in flecks of pale light, and her burned arm goes first.
She remembers that Chang'e's paper said the body goes first.
The star under her right sleeve is the only warm thing on her, and it keeps growing colder.
She tells Guinevere that she brought color to her world, and that before they met her world was darker than the void.
She says her ignorance and foolishness led to her father's death: he was a soldier to the end and died saving her.
Under the tree she had told Guinevere only that her father liked the stars.
She says her father told her to stay back at the shelter door; she did not, so he came back for her. She says she shouted the same words, 'Stay back!', at Guinevere in the corridor.
She says that after his death atonement and destroying the Enders became her only purpose, and she chose to be alone for fear of losing someone again.
She says Guinevere saw her hiding in the shadows, reached out without hesitation and chose to be her partner.
She says Guinevere took her to the summer fireworks, the girls' house and the amusement park.
She says she kept everything from those days in a box: ticket stubs, a paper fan, even the napkin from a doughnut.
She says she wore the pink-haired keychain into the corridor instead of keeping it in the box.
She calls the Emblem of Hope Guinevere gave her her most treasured possession.
She says the Will of the Planet showed her a 'future' that Guinevere must never know.
She asks Guinevere's forgiveness and says she would again choose to betray her in order to protect her.
Warmth comes through the star at her wrist and her body stops fading.
She had read the page of Chang'e's paper about the black hole twice in the library.
When her body begins to recover she thinks of Plan B.
She laughs in the dark when Guinevere says she once phoned in the middle of the night to tell her to go to bed.
Meeting Guinevere again in the light she says, 'Beneath the shooting star, we have met again, Guinevere.'
Before the strike on the Matrix her voice came over Guinevere's open line: 'This is the final farewell.'
She returns with her left sleeve gone to the elbow; the arm under it, burned raw before the charge, is whole again.
She flies down to three dark giants in the rubble and lights their eyes with her palm without saying a word.
She tells Fanny the giants are hers and answer to her.
She has no comm of her own, so Guinevere gives her hers.
When Lesley puts her on the frontline she grounds her staff, brings her heels together and answers 'Understood, Commander.'
She reaches over and sets Guinevere's left bow straight.
She tells Guinevere quietly that she saw the end and no longer knows if it was the only one.
She flies on violet wings beside Guinevere and sends her three giants into the road.
She recognizes the field's hum and orders everyone to land at once, without explaining why.
When the field reaches her, her violet wings fold into nothing and she drops onto the road on her feet.
Under the field the orb of her staff gives no light.
Selena sees her kneel over Guinevere in an Ender's robe, blue-lavender hair down her back.
She gets between an Ender and Guinevere with her dark staff and is knocked into a doorway.
Weeks among the Enders taught her how they move; she holds her staff across her body like a pole and reads which one will swing.
With both stars dark, her fingers still find Guinevere's wrist between Enders.
When her star lights again, violet wings open at her back.
She had once walked the Storm Citadel's hanging streets.
She says the portal is torn, not closed.
She had not planned on a next year, yet a card on her desk still says 'Same place. Next year.' in her small square letters.

ties.t: Guinevere chose to become her partner and brought color to her world.
She says her father, a soldier, died saving her.
The three giants are hers and answer to her.
She takes Lesley's order and calls her Commander.
Lesley puts her on frontline assault with Guinevere.
Fanny covers her in the street, and she nods her thanks.
Obsidia had known Vexana would turn against her.
She says she kept her keepsakes from her days with Guinevere in it.

gear.name: Vexana's staff
gear.t: A dark Ender staff with an orb. Under the field its orb goes dark and she uses it like a pole.

gear.name: Ender robe
gear.t: An Ender's robe, torn, which she wears into battle.

gear.name: Emblem of Hope
gear.t: A star worn under her right sleeve at the wrist, given to her by Guinevere.

gear.name: pink-haired keychain
gear.t: A little pink-haired doll on a clip inside her sleeve, beside the star.

gear.name: violet wings
gear.t: Wings that let her fly; the field folds them away.

gear.name: Eternal Guards
gear.t: Three giant machines with swords that answer to her.

facts.t: Inside the black hole her feet had gone to light and her knees were going, and she had been crying.
She had promised never to ask about Vexana's past, but Vexana told her anyway.
She thinks that 'Stay back' were Vexana's father's words, and that Vexana took the claw for her in the corridor.
She shouts into the dark that she heard everything.
She says her will to protect Vexana burns as bright as her will to protect the world.
The night no call came, she called Vexana's number out of habit, followed the ringing into Vexana's room and found the box.
She says she came to the Academy to prove she did not need her father's empire, and that even her top marks drew only a cold rebuke from him.
She says she once waited all day outside her father's office, her heart full of hope.
She says people called her a spoiled little princess whose achievements were her father's, and that she swore to train even harder.
That night a roll of Vexana's tape turned up on her jacket.
She says the first thing Vexana ever said to her was 'You are strong, Guinevere,' and that it felt like the first time someone saw her for herself.
She says that when they first met she was sure of teaming up with Vexana, but Vexana was cold and turned her down.
She says that before Vexana her only company was her security detail.
She says she made the Emblem of Hope she gave Vexana with her own hands.
She says Vexana taught her she has more than money to rely on.
Her father sent word through Hester at the gate: come home, or lose her place in the House. She did not go.
She says she will give up being a lady of status and start over if she must.
Fading, she remembers that even Fanny said the Aspirants always stand united, and her star lights.
She takes Vexana's hand and tells her this is the miracle they created.
She lands on the platform laughing, her pink hair wild, both drones burning at her shoulders.
She tells Fanny she held on to Fanny's words inside the black hole.
At the seawall she had told Layla, chin up, 'Her name is Vexana.'
She wears a little black-haired doll on her cracked arm guard.
She takes Vexana's healed left arm in both hands and turns it over, as if counting the fingers.
She flies on wings of gold light with two drones circling her.
She fights with her fists and punches straight into an Ender's core.
She raises her fists and says, 'We have only one Aspirant spirit.'
Far out over the water when Fanny calls to land, she flies back high and fast toward Vexana instead of down.
The field takes her last: her drones die, her gold wings break into sparks and she falls.
She falls through a shop's awning onto the stones at the mouth of the cut and does not get up.
After the fall something in her side stabs every time she breathes.
She reaches for her power the way she always does, and nothing comes.
For weeks her lit star was her only proof that Vexana was alive somewhere.
She has always liked Selena a little, as she likes anyone who does not care what a room thinks of them.
She looks at Selena past the plate and claws, for the girl inside, the way she looked at Vexana on the platform.
With no drones and no wings she fights with her hands, which she had before any of it.
She hears Hester's old lesson, 'Hands home,' from a dawn beside a sandbag.
She steps in under an Ender's arm and cracks its core with her bare fist.
Every night in the training hall she trained fists first, then drones.
She tells Vexana, 'Same place. Next year.'

ties.t: She says she would never give up on Vexana.
Her father wants her in the family business and rebukes her efforts.
Her father threatens to take her place in the House.
Hester taught her to keep her hands home.
She remembers Joe's lesson on how long an open Ender gives you.
Fanny gives her the middle of the gap.
She has always liked Selena a little from class.
She says she made the Emblem she gave Vexana with her own hands.
She fights on the frontline with Vexana.
She came to the Academy to prove herself.
She says her security detail was her only company before Vexana.

gear.name: Guinevere's drones
gear.t: Two drones that circle her with yellow rings and strike Enders; the right one shows off.

gear.name: gold wings
gear.t: Wings of gold light she flies on; the field breaks them into sparks.

gear.name: Emblem of Hope
gear.t: A small gold star at her collar that answers Vexana's star.

gear.name: black-haired doll
gear.t: A little doll on a clip on her arm guard.

gear.name: the channel
gear.t: Her earpiece for the channel; she lends it to Vexana and later loses it in her fall.

gear.name: Guinevere's bows
gear.t: Bows in her hair; Vexana straightens the left one.

facts.t: She stands at the rail with her blades held low; she has not raised them since her last arcs at the Matrix's crown.
Vexana's farewell came into her own ear over Guinevere's open line.
She had said 'The Aspirants always stand united' with her blades raised at Vexana.
She thinks the Matrix is only pushed back, because the Shield never calls a thing dead without a body.
Faced with Vexana's giants she neither strikes nor lowers her blades.
Her rig hums louder after the pair return; it had gone thin and quiet when 'traitor' went down the channel that morning, and she had blamed the fight.
At the lot by the dome's foot she told the soldiers she had watched two girls off a black ship (Ruby and Angela) fight a giant for the city, and would answer for them on her own word.
She thinks an order puts Vexana on the line but not yet at her back.
She tells Layla her plan worked, sees Layla's hand is not quite still, and lets it go.
She does not ask Vexana what end she saw.
She fights at roof height with her cable and thrusters, swinging round a lamppost into an Ender's back.
She once told a little girl on her hip that flying felt great; it still does, and for once the Shield part of her lets her grin.
For one beat she hesitates to defend Vexana, who wears an Ender's robe and staff.
She drops between Vexana and an Ender and kills it, then turns away and leaves her back to Vexana.
She protests when Layla says 'it's our time to shine', which is her line.
She once saw the Storm Citadel in a shaking film in Joe's class.
Seeing the field come, she calls the frontline to land.
Her rig dies under the field while she is two stories up, and she drops onto the road.
She watched soldiers hold ground with no suits at all for two years.
With plain steel blades she says, 'As humanity's last hope, I can't afford to give up.'
She builds a wall across the narrowest part of the cut from a door, a shop sign and a car, leaving one gap.
She shouts to Guinevere to wait for the swing.
After Guinevere's punch, she moves to the edge of the gap and gives Guinevere the middle.
She built the wall the way suitless soldiers taught her: nobody swings until an Ender swings, then steel goes into the core.
She tells Layla that holding up the sign while the Ender looked at her counts as covering.
She kneels by the crying boy and comforts him in a soft voice, nothing like her command voice.
Her ears go red when Layla calls her her teammate.
She says her brother would have held the street alone.
She says she does not care what Tigreal would have done; she is not doing it alone.
She admits that this morning she would have called Vexana a traitor on the channel.
She tells Guinevere, 'Don't give up.'
On the sand outside the dome she was the first to fight back to back with Layla, and this morning she told Layla to lead.
She sweeps her blade back over her own shoulder into an Ender's chest without looking round.
She tells Ruby she has the only charge left.
When her rig wakes she says low to her blades, 'A strong Aspirant spirit becomes the blade that cuts through despair.'
She asks Layla 'All rested up?' with a perfectly straight face.
She pulls Layla up and they stand back to back on the heap, cannon and blades lit.

ties.t: They fight back to back in the cut.
Tigreal is her brother.
Suitless Shield soldiers taught her how to hold a street.
She covers Vexana and then trusts her with her back.
She gives Guinevere the middle of the gap.
She comforts the crying boy.
She fights on the frontline in the Academy district.
She answers Lesley's orders with 'Understood.'
She saw the Citadel's film in Joe's class.
She vouched for Ruby at the lot by the dome's foot.
She vouched for Angela at the lot by the dome's foot.

gear.name: Fanny's blades
gear.t: Two blades with cyan edges that arc with power; under the field they are plain steel.

gear.name: Fanny's rig
gear.t: A hip rig with thrusters and a cable that lets her fly; it dies under the field and wakes after.

facts.t: She counts under her breath while the pair are inside the black hole.
Fanny thinks Layla counts everything.
She tells the returning pair they took twelve seconds.
She answers 'Obviously' when Fanny says her plan worked, though her hand on the stock is not quite still.
She kneels on a roof with her cannon on her shoulder; her lips move as its cells fill.
She grins on her roof during the fight.
She calls 'And now, it's our time to shine!', which Fanny says is her line.
She asks Fanny what the spreading field is.
When her cannon dies she says, 'Huh...? No way... What...'
She climbs down a drainpipe with the dead cannon on her back and stands at Fanny's left.
Seeing Selena's true shape she says 'Why...' with all the edge gone from her voice.
She stands at the wall with her dead cannon on her back, counting.
She timed the Enders: from the lift of the arm to the split of the chest is always a count of three.
She thinks of the wall as the alley thing, which she once spied on from a dark gallery and then pretended never to have heard of.
Vexana knows which Ender will swing; Layla knows when.
The soldiers and Fanny strike on her count.
She throws her shoulder against the sliding shop sign to hold the wall.
She protests that she was only holding up a sign.
She thinks Fanny stole the idea of covering from the breach.
She tells the crying boy, 'If you're scared, you can hide behind me.'
She once said it to Roger as a joke; now she means it.
On the day of the breach she heard Joe's soft voice over the girl with the pink rabbit, then walked away to argue over who covered whom.
On her lab's top shelf a pink box with a teal ribbon stands beside her trophy.
She tells the boy Fanny is her teammate.
She notices Fanny is no longer looking past her.
She wonders whether Selena sent the Enders or just left.
She had called Vexana a traitor at the seawall, to Guinevere's face.
Since the sand outside the dome she has gone first on every raid.
She counts silently and drops so that Fanny's blade can pass over her into an Ender.
Her cannon wakes on her back, its cells lighting cyan from the bottom up.
She answers Fanny's joke with 'Since when were we resting?'
Her cannon fires on her own count in the last fight.

ties.t: She calls Fanny her teammate.
She lets the crying boy hide behind her.
She once told Roger to hide behind her as a joke.
She remembers Joe on the avenue the day of the breach.
She fights on the frontline with her cannon.
Her lab holds the pink box and her trophy.

gear.name: Layla's cannon
gear.t: A cannon with cyan cells along its stock that fill as it charges; dead under the field, alive after.

facts.t: She knocks the last Ender off the rail and leans on it, her scythe on her shoulder.
When the two lights shoot out she says, 'The dawn is finally coming.'
She bumps her shoulder against Angela's.
After Vexana is put on the line, she tells Angela, 'She did that to us. Watched first. Then let us in.'
Fanny remembers soldiers holding rifles up at two girls off a black ship (Ruby and Angela) at the lot by the dome's foot.
She walks the edge of Angela's shield with her scythe crackling.
Her scythe is the one weapon still lit under the field.
She stands over the wounded at the top of the cut.
Her scythe was built by Oro and nothing in it runs on aspirant power, so the field found nothing to put out.
When an Ender throws Angela into a wall, a rage comes up in her.
The rage came once before, in a burning avenue: she cut down everything in front of her, a lamp post and a wall, then raised her scythe over a crying child.
She knows the rage never cared what it hit, and hers is the only live blade in a street full of wounded.
She decides Angela should not have to call her back again.
She makes herself hear the boy's crying to hold on.
She makes one cut into the Ender's core, and no more; the lamp post and wall behind it stand.
Her eyes stay blue.
She tells Angela she made that elbow and can mend it.
She tells the channel, 'What I'm supposed to do, I'll see through to the end, responsibly.'
On Oro every post was chosen for her, inside a golden birdcage; this one she chooses to keep.
She stands between an Ender and Angela and says coldly, 'Don't get in my way!'
She kneels beside Angela with a hand on her shoulder.
She laughs once on the channel when Angela's shield comes back.

ties.t: She bumps shoulders with Angela and protects her.
She stands between an Ender and the hurt Angela.
She once lived on Oro, where every post was chosen for her.
She is rear support, with the wounded.
She says she made Angela's elbow and can mend it.

gear.name: Ruby's scythe
gear.t: A crackling scythe built by Oro with no aspirant power in it, so it stays lit under the field.

facts.t: Her pink shield stands over the four of them on the platform.
She lets the shield fold away and tells Ruby, 'People come back.'
Fanny remembers soldiers holding rifles up at two girls off a black ship (Ruby and Angela) at the lot by the dome's foot, until she vouched for them.
At the top of the cut she holds her shield over wounded soldiers with both hands and talks to the men under it the whole time.
Under the field her shield flickers and goes out, and she stands with her hands raised, holding nothing.
She whispers on the channel, 'Is this the end?'
She kneels among the wounded at the top of the cut.
Without her shield she lifts a slab off a soldier's legs with bare hands, which no human could do; her body runs on her own cell.
She throws herself over the soldier, takes the claw across her back and is thrown into a wall; her left arm hangs wrong and sparks at the elbow.
She sits against the wall looking up at Ruby with her mouth open.
She sees Ruby's eyes stay blue and closes her mouth.
She says Ruby's name, not as a shout.
She says the elbow hurts and that she knows what that means.
In the burning avenue she had asked Ruby how to stop the rage.
Her pink shield opens again over the wounded when the field dies.
She says brightly on the channel, 'Battery recharged!'

ties.t: She tells Ruby people come back.
Ruby says she made Angela's elbow.
She shields the soldier from a claw with her own back.
She holds her shield over the wounded.
She is rear support, with the wounded.

gear.name: Angela's shield
gear.t: A pink shield of light that curves over people; the field puts it out.

gear.name: Angela's cell
gear.t: Her own power cell, which keeps her body running under the field.

facts.t: When Chang'e says her paper was only a guess, Lesley answers that it is now tested and to log it.
As commander she says Vexana's name for the first time that day.
She watched the Matrix fire on Vexana, then watched Vexana charge it.
She puts Vexana on the line for frontline assault with Guinevere, her voice level.
When told Vexana's file still says Missing, she says 'Change it.'
She concludes that something else is coming through the mouth.
She calls on mobile support to report.
She gives the frontline the Academy district as its ground, with the full shelters at their back, and keeps rear support close behind.
She reports that comms hold but suits do not, and it is not the storm from the records.
She stands behind Chang'e's chair with one hand on its back, as she has all day.
She thinks of the Citadel as the second front, here.
The coil on her rifle had run cooler than the old one since the dawn she fitted it.
She has a machine eye Chang'e built at the old base; it draws the deck in thin teal lines and uses no aspirant power.
The day Chang'e gave her the rifle she thought it would still work in the dark.
She orders the frontline back into the bay road cut to hold one street.
She held streets like that for the Shield before there were any suits.
She once told a room of Shield officers that imagination is Chang'e's weapon, with Chang'e on a crate beside her, and did not know Chang'e kept it.
She used to tell her little brother every night, 'Then I'll stand in front,' while he held her sleeve.
She always said No when Chang'e asked for a place on the rotation.
She pleads, 'Don't make me do this. Chang'e...'
She had given her reason only once: in the field, she cannot see Chang'e.
On the deck she can see Chang'e, and Chang'e is asking her, so she agrees to the plan.
She holds her fire one heartbeat, waiting for Chang'e's call.
She fires over Chang'e's head into the Ender's open core.
She always stops a step away from Chang'e.
This time she kneels and puts her arms around Chang'e and the dented robot both.
She had carried her vow since the night of the crater and thought it once in a tower window across the water, but never said it aloud.
She tells Chang'e, 'Ever since that day, I vowed to keep you safe, Chang'e.'
She tells every Aspirant whose suit went dark, 'As long as we have heart, we will never surrender.'
Her machine eye catches lightning crawling over the bell tower's roof.
Seeing the lights come back she says, 'There's still... hope... ah.'
She agrees the Matrix is gone back only for now.
Since the founding a caramel cup has turned up outside the lab door after every long night; neither she nor Chang'e has ever said a word about it.
When Chang'e says 'You owe me a pudding,' she answers 'Two.'

ties.t: She vowed to keep Chang'e safe.
She takes the shot on Chang'e's call.
She stood in front of her little brother every night.
She held streets for the Shield before suits existed.
She orders the frontline into the cut.
She puts Vexana on the line.
She commands from the deck behind Chang'e's chair.

gear.name: Lesley's rifle
gear.t: An old bolt rifle with a coil Chang'e built; the coil dies under the field but the old action still fires by hand.

gear.name: machine eye
gear.t: An eye Chang'e built that draws the world in teal lines; it uses no aspirant power.

facts.t: Vexana remembers that Chang'e's paper said the body goes first in the black hole.
She reports that two signals came back out of the black hole, though no reading had ever come back out of one.
She says quietly, 'I can't... believe it.'
She says her paper was only a guess.
She reports that every suit's line on her board has turned and is climbing.
She points out that Vexana's file still says Missing.
She reports the mouth is clear but the storm signal has not moved.
She names the ship as the one from the oldest record: the Storm Citadel.
She reports the landings have stopped and the frontline is pushing the Enders back.
She built the coil on Lesley's rifle.
When the field drops her crescents she does not pick them up.
She built Lesley's machine eye at the old base, before there were any suits.
She says, 'Big Sis said imagination is my weapon,' and goes back to her keys.
She traces the field's hum to one long thing running through the middle of the ship.
She says it reads alive, like an Ender's insides, and calls it a spine.
With an Ender at the window she tells Lesley, 'Stay at my back, Big Sis. That worked last time.'
Her plan: she holds still, the Ender strikes at her, its core opens, and Lesley fires.
She says that if she hides, the Ender strikes where Lesley cannot see and the street goes blind; Mr. Bunny will take the hit.
She says, 'I can't keep hiding in Big Sis's shadow. I'll fight and grow, too.'
She tells Lesley not to fire early and to wait for her call.
She folds her hands and sits still under the claw, rain running down her glasses.
She calls 'Front', and Mr. Bunny swings in front of her face.
When Lesley hugs her she does not push her away.
She says Mr. Bunny showed her Lesley on a roof with a rifle, night after night; she told him to turn around.
She admits she looked anyway.
On the avenue the night the Enders came back, she looked straight up at Lesley's window, knowing which one it was.
When her crescents rise again she tells them 'Good morning.'
She tuned the note of Lesley's rifle coil herself.
She reads the sky the way she reads a console.
She sees the spine reads nothing and thinks somebody cut it.
She says the Matrix is not dead, only gone back.
She touches Mr. Bunny's crooked ear and says 'You owe me a pudding.'
She lets Lesley's hand rest on the back of her chair.

ties.t: She plans the shot and Lesley takes it.
Lesley vowed to keep her safe.
Her robot takes the hit for her.
She wrote the paper on the black hole.
She built Lesley's machine eye.
She built the coil on Lesley's rifle.
She works at the console on the deck.
A pudding cup turns up outside her lab door.

gear.name: Mr. Bunny
gear.t: Her floating robot with a screen face, which takes the Ender's claw for her.

gear.name: crescents
gear.t: Small crescents that turn in the air around her; they fall under the field and rise after.

gear.name: Chang'e's console
gear.t: Her console showing a line for every suit in the city.

gear.name: glasses
gear.t: Her glasses; rain runs down them, and they sit crooked after the fight.

facts.t: She calls the Mother Matrix 'just big and useless' around her lollipop.
She once sold Vexana a gray Ender shoulder plate one night in the dead ground.
She sold Vexana the plates because she wanted to see how a pawn gets out of the game.
The recall in her cells goes thin while the Matrix reels, then comes back hotter and nearer.
She sits at the edge of the bell tower in her school uniform, making her lollipop last.
She knows the Citadel's hum: every Ender she ever passed carried a small piece of it.
Her bones call the hum 'home', and she answers that so does everybody else.
She calls the one pulling at her the huntress.
Her smile when the Citadel arrives is none of the ones she keeps.
Her rule is never to move first and to let the huntress show her hand.
The field passes through her bone by bone and finds nothing to take.
In class she read out the top row of the Academy's table of suits; every number was higher than the ones she sold.
She judges the field good work and thinks she would have built it the same way.
On the broken wall she once thought she would break it herself if anyone pointed it at the Academy.
For weeks before the charge she had not heard Guinevere laugh.
She had already ruled out going back to the Matrix or a hero's grave; one road was left, her own, up to the huntress's seat.
She knows that saying no means betraying her own kind for good and being hunted without end.
She would rather live as Selena, a name she chose herself, than be someone else's pawn.
She wears the polite smile she learned from humans.
She pushes Silverbolt into overload and its lightning surges into her, closing plate over her arms.
She looks once at the cut where Guinevere lies and steps off the tower.
She drops from the sky between the long-legged Enders and Guinevere, cracking the stones.
Her two small horns grow out of her blonde hair; in class they sat in front of a dark headband, which is gone now.
She tells Guinevere, 'Take a good look. This is the real me.'
When a boy on the Academy stairs called her dangerous, she waved her lollipop and said 'One day, when the haze clears...'
In class she sat in the front row, came in late every morning with her guardian's note, and slept on her arms through lessons.
Under Guinevere's steady look her smile goes, showing a face Guinevere has never seen.
The bell tower is where she always does her thinking.
She follows the recall back to its sender the way she follows a fault through a circuit on the workshop bench.
She does not remember a single minute of the last time she met her maker.
Under Obsidia's finger her blood goes quiet and wants to stay quiet; she notes it and files it.
She tells Obsidia, 'I'll never be your puppet again!'
She has copied every face she has ever met.
She refuses to take the throne: it would be the same board, a better chair.
She tells Obsidia she does not care about purification: 'Give me back my freedom!'
She had walked out of every fight of her life without a scratch until Obsidia's weapon went through her side.
She had never said she would save humanity.
She tells her maker, 'Sorry, ma'am.'
She tells Obsidia, 'But I still prefer life at the academy!'
She charges at Obsidia's open arms.

ties.t: She greets Obsidia as her creator.
She declares war on her maker.
A woman gathered her up out of the mud; Karina wants to see her graduate.
She pushes her machine into overload.
Lesley calls her as mobile support.
She says she prefers life at the Academy.
She has missed Guinevere's laugh and watches her fall.

gear.name: Silverbolt
gear.t: Her dragon-shaped machine; its overload lightning starts her change.

gear.name: lollipop
gear.t: A lollipop always in her cheek, which she usually lets melt.

gear.name: fruit drop
gear.t: A fruit drop in a twist of paper she keeps in her pocket.

gear.name: Selena's true form
gear.t: Her full Ender shape of white, blue and gold plate with a pale mane.

gear.name: Selena's blades
gear.t: Four black-and-gold blades that hang around her, and a blade of crackling light along one arm.

facts.t: She stands at the top of the steps in her throne hall, deep among the hanging blocks of the Storm Citadel.
She watches the battle through the eyes of the gray Enders on her outer blocks.
She saw a human's belief light a machine of Ender plates that had stayed dead under her own hand in the hollow.
She had told the girl on her prow that nothing made of matter ever comes back out of the black point.
She does not know how the two lights came back out.
On every world she helped end, nothing had wounded the Will's body until two human girls did.
She had known Vexana would turn since the day she looked at that sleeve.
She calls the Matrix's retreat 'merely a prelude to the end.'
A pulse tells her where her pawn is: alive on a tower over the Academy, having obeyed no call and sent no word for days.
She tells her weapon that her finest creation has gone off-script.
She had planned for both outcomes: watch if the body won, go in herself once the mouth was clear if not.
She holds back the last call so her pawn must first show its own shape.
She sets the Storm Citadel moving: 'Let us begin the final purge.'
Through her Enders' eyes she sees every Aspirant in the street burning bright.
She wakes the field by laying two fire-ringed black spheres against her throne.
After seeing her pawn stand before the humans in its own shape, she sends the last call, which carries where she stands.
She thinks the finest thing she made might tell her what comes after, for her kind.
Watching Selena come, she feels a pleasure she has not known in a very long time.
She says to no one, 'Look at how much you've grown, my child.'
She opens the hanging blocks along the line of her call to let Selena through.
She has long hair running from gold into pink, a black and magenta gown, and red gloves that end in claws.
Her face is smooth shell with a cold sheen, and her eyes burn violet; she is not surprised Selena came.
She greets Selena: 'It has been a while, my little doll.'
She tells Selena her name: Obsidia.
She tips Selena's face up with one finger and looks it over like something she carved herself.
She says destruction gives rise to new life, and that this is the meaning of purification.
She says the next thing to destroy is 'a pawn with no surprises left.'
She raises chains of bone from the floor without once looking at them.
She tells Selena, 'Savor your final moments, my dear Selena.'
Seeing Selena's full true form, her face shows something close to pleasure.
She fights unhurried, giving ground down the stairs and keeping Selena at her weapon's length.
She stands on the tilting stairs as if they were level.
When Selena cuts her cheek the shell splits in a thin dark line and no blood comes.
For the first time that day the calm leaves her face, and she gives no more ground.
She smirks as her point-blank shot throws Selena out of the Citadel.
She flies out of the smoke after Selena.
She remembers keeping her post at the edge of a great door among drifting stones while a world went dark, and cities under orange fire after.
Of everything she has watched, she watched longest a small thing curled like a sad girl at the end of a row in the nest, and later under a tarp in the rain.
Inside the gold fire of her change she says, 'You cannot save humanity.'
In her new form she opens her arms and says, 'Come back, my puppet.'

ties.t: She looks Selena over like something she carved herself.
Her weapon goes through Selena's side.
She knew Vexana would turn.
She sees through her Enders' eyes and commands them.
Her grip on the throne wakes the whole ship.
She planned to watch if the body finished the humans.
She stands in her throne hall.

gear.name: Obsidia's weapon
gear.t: A long silver-pink weapon that comes to her hand, lashes out at a finger's lift and fires bolts.

gear.name: small black spheres
gear.t: Two black spheres ringed with fire that wake the field when laid against the throne.

gear.name: bone chains
gear.t: Chains of bone with spikes that rise from the floor and pin Selena.

gear.name: Obsidia's new form
gear.t: A taller form of silver and gold plate with a crown of silver points and wide energy wings.

facts.t: Guinevere says they stopped the Matrix's invasion and saved the world.
It hangs at the edge of the Singularity, half in its light, wings flung wide, its chest shut over the wound.
Struck at the chest by the two returning lights, it goes slowly back into the star until the glow closes over it.
Fanny thinks of it as pushed back, not dead.
Selena calls it big and useless.
Obsidia calls it the body; it grew her throne for her when she woke.
It withdraws below the Citadel's keel with its wings half folded, magenta glowing on the seam where its chest plates shut over the wound, back into the dark where it heals.
It fired a beam at a machine of Ender plates that stood in front of it.
It gave way before the two lights that came back out of the black point.
On every world Obsidia helped end, nothing had wounded the Will's body until two human girls did.
After the battle its signature still sits faint behind the Singularity's light.
Chang'e says it is not dead, only gone back.

ties.t: Obsidia thinks of it as the Will's body.
It grew Obsidia's throne.
Obsidia planned to watch it finish the humans.

facts.t: Vexana says it showed her a 'future' that Guinevere must never know.
Guinevere says there is nothing to fear in it and she would snatch Vexana right back.
Obsidia calls the Mother Matrix the Will's body.
Vexana says he was a soldier until his last breath and died saving her.
Vexana told Guinevere only that he liked the stars.
Vexana says he told her to stay back at the shelter door; she did not, so he came back for her.
Guinevere thinks his words, 'Stay back', are the ones Vexana shouted at her in the corridor.

ties.t: He is Vexana's father; she says he died to save her.

facts.t: Guinevere says he has an empire and a family business, and that he answered her top marks with 'Stop being so stubborn and focus more on the family business!'
Guinevere says she once waited outside his office all day, full of hope.
Through the gap in his door his dark sleeve with a fur cuff turned pages until dusk and never reached for her paper.
He sent word through Hester at the gate: come home, or lose her place in the House.

ties.t: He is Guinevere's father.
He can take Guinevere's place in the House from her.

facts.t: Guinevere's father sent word through her at the gate: come home or lose her place in the House.
At dawn years ago, beside a sandbag that hardly swung, she taught Guinevere 'Hands home.'

ties.t: She taught Guinevere to fight with her hands.
She carries his message to Guinevere.

facts.t: She is out with the rescue teams; one of the lamps in the flooded wards would be hers.
She told Selena 'Come home after', without saying after what.
She still wants to see Selena's graduation.
Selena's first memory is of a woman with a lamp who knelt in the mud and gathered her up.
When Selena gave herself a name at a rainy window, Karina said 'Selena it is.'
During the battle she carries a lamp from door to door in the flooded wards.

ties.t: She gathered Selena up and wants to see her graduate.
She works with the rescue teams.
She carries a lamp from door to door.

facts.t: In his class Fanny saw the Storm Citadel in a shaking film.
He taught that Enders don't strike easily, and when one does, that is how long you get.
On the avenue on the day of the breach he knelt over a girl with a pink rabbit and spoke in a voice he never used in class; then a slab came down on him.

ties.t: Fanny saw the Citadel's film in his class.
Guinevere remembers his lesson.

ties.with: the girl with the pink rabbit
ties.t: He knelt over her on the avenue.

facts.t: Layla once told him as a joke he could hide behind her, and he ran across open ground for the spot behind her.

ties.t: He once ran to hide behind Layla.

facts.t: Fanny says her brother would have held the street alone.
Fanny says she does not care what Tigreal would have done.

ties.t: He is Fanny's brother.

facts.t: Every night he held Lesley's sleeve while she told him 'Then I'll stand in front.'

ties.t: He is Lesley's little brother.
Lesley promised to stand in front of him.

facts.t: His ears go flat when the floor hums.
He keeps floating at Chang'e's shoulder with his screen on when the field hits.
Chang'e's plan has him take the Ender's hit.
He swings in front of Chang'e's face and takes the claw on his casing, spinning down the console.
He comes back with one ear crooked and a dent across his casing; his screen flickers, then finds its smile with the eyes shut.
He showed Chang'e Lesley on a roof with a rifle, night after night.
He hangs at Chang'e's shoulder with one ear crooked.

ties.t: He is Chang'e's robot.
He takes the claw meant for Chang'e.

facts.t: It shifts its claws beside Selena on the bell tower.
It crouches against Selena's hip with rain running off its plates.
Its head comes up and turns toward the Storm Citadel.
It only ever moves when some part of Selena means it to.
Selena presses its head down against her knee.
The blue along its seams does not flicker when the field passes.
Its head turns down the hill toward the cut where Guinevere lies.
Under Selena's hands its motor purrs.
Pushed into overload, its seams go from blue to white, it shrieks and shines silver as it did the night she named it.
Lightning pours out of its seams over the tiles.
Guinevere remembers it clicking at Selena's heel in class.

ties.t: It moves only when part of Selena means it to.

facts.t: He cries in a shelter doorway up the cut.
He comes down the street looking for someone and finds the wall instead.
He takes a fistful of the back of Layla's uniform and holds on.
He asks Layla whether Fanny is her friend.
A soldier with his arm in a sling walks him back up the street.
Ruby makes herself hear his crying to keep hold of herself.

ties.t: Layla lets him hide behind her.
Fanny comforts him.

facts.t: A soldier with his arm in a sling takes the small boy's hand and walks him back up the street.

ties.t: He takes the boy back to safety.

facts.t: A slab of fallen wall pins his legs until Angela lifts it off.
He drags himself clear.
When an Ender drops at him, Angela throws herself over him.

ties.t: Angela shields him with her back.

facts.t: At the lot by the dome's foot he asked Fanny 'On whose word?' when she vouched for the two girls off a black ship.

ties.t: He is a sergeant among the soldiers.

things.name: the boy on the Academy stairs

facts.t: He once called Selena dangerous on the Academy stairs, and everybody laughed.

things.name: the girl with the pink rabbit
aliases: a little girl on her hip

facts.t: Fanny once carried a little girl on her hip and told her that flying felt great.
On the avenue on the day of the breach, Joe knelt over a girl with a pink rabbit and spoke to her softly.

ties.t: Fanny carried her.
Joe knelt over her before the slab fell.

facts.t: Destroying the Enders was once Vexana's only reason to go on.
Obsidia sees through the eyes of the gray Enders on her outer blocks.
The Enders on the platforms showed Obsidia everything and understood none of it.
Obsidia saw every Ender on the platforms turn on Vexana.
Every Ender carries a small piece of the Citadel's hum.
They drop by the hundred from the bellies of small ships and leap from the Citadel's lowest towers.
An Ender lifts its arm before it strikes, and its chest plates split open as it does.
Once the field is up, they walk up from the water in no hurry.
A plain round rings off Ender plate and goes only into an open core.
They never strike easily.
Their chest plates are shut except while they strike.
From the lift of an Ender's arm to the split of its chest plates is always a count of three.
Gray Enders stand in rows in the Citadel's open holds without moving.
They keep coming up out of the water after the field dies.
Selena thinks every suit at the Academy was built from Enders.

ties.t: Obsidia sees through their eyes.
They turned on Vexana on the platforms.

facts.t: Four of them step out of the smoke, taller than the morning's Enders, on long jointed legs like spiders standing up.
They come close behind Selena and do not reach for her.
They charge at Guinevere together, and their legs tangle in the narrow cut.
All four lie dead before the gap, one across another, so the rest must climb them.

ties.t: They are a taller kind of Ender.

facts.t: It climbs the tower's face hand over hand, straight toward the console.
It bursts the glass and hauls itself half into the deck.
It is three times Chang'e's height, its chest plated shut.
It bends toward Chang'e but does not strike at once.
Its claw strikes Mr. Bunny instead of Chang'e.
Lesley's round goes into its open core, and it falls away down the tower.

ties.t: It bends to strike at Chang'e.

facts.t: Three dark giants lie in the rubble under the platform, their swords across the stones.
Their eyes light yellow one by one when Vexana lays her palm on the first.
They rise out of the stone, swords dragging, until their heads stand over the rail.
Vexana says they are hers and answer to her.
One wears a gray shoulder plate on a purple arm, a plate Selena sold to Vexana.
They land in the road and their swords fall together, sending light along the road that knocks the Enders flat.
The field puts out their yellow eyes; one sword falls by its own weight.
When the field dies Vexana relights them, and the last takes up its sword.
Their three swords come up together at Vexana's call.
They hold the bay road in the last fight.

ties.t: They answer to Vexana.

facts.t: Vexana says that as one of the Aspirants she must do what needs to be done.
Guinevere remembers the saying that the Aspirants always stand united.
Obsidia sees every Aspirant in the street burning bright.
Lesley speaks to every Aspirant whose suit has gone dark.
Under the field Selena watches the Aspirants go out one after another.
Selena was never one of the Aspirants whose suit went dark.
Fanny thinks the Shield never calls a thing dead without a body.
At the lot by the dome's foot its soldiers held rifles up at two girls off a black ship.
Fanny has a 'Shield part' of her that usually keeps her from grinning.
Its soldiers hold ground with no suits at all.
Lesley held narrow streets for the Shield before there were suits.
Lesley once spoke to a room of Shield officers.
Shield soldiers help drag and stack the wall.
Its soldiers fire only into open chests, on Layla's count.

ties.t: Its suitless soldiers taught Fanny how to build the wall.

facts.t: Lesley puts Vexana on it for frontline assault with Guinevere.
On the platforms it turns to meet the Citadel's Enders: a gold light, a violet one, cyan blades and a cannon.
Its ground is the Academy district, from the bay road up to the hall.
Fanny calls it to land when the field comes.
Lesley orders it back into the bay road cut to hold one street.

ties.t: It takes Lesley's orders.

facts.t: It is told to stay close behind the frontline.
Lesley puts it behind the frontline, with the wounded.
With rear support placed among the wounded, the wounded have nothing else.

ties.t: It takes Lesley's orders.

facts.t: Lesley calls on mobile support to report, and Selena lets the call go by.
Its light on Chang'e's console keeps blinking.
Its light still blinks after the field dies.

ties.t: Selena is mobile support.

facts.t: Small lamps move through the flooded wards and stop at every doorway.
All the rescue teams are out today, Karina among them.
Their lamps stop moving and point up at the lightning.
Karina carries a lamp from door to door with them.
Wounded soldiers shelter under Angela's shield at the top of the cut.
When the shield goes out the men under it look up.
They lie along the house fronts below the shelters.
The street is full of them when Ruby's rage rises.
Angela's shield opens over them again.
Guinevere's father threatened that she would lose her place in it unless she came home.
Guinevere says her security detail was her only company before Vexana.

ties.t: They kept Guinevere company before Vexana.

facts.t: Vexana wears one under her right sleeve; inside the black hole it is the only warm thing on her.
Vexana calls it her most treasured possession; it reminds her she is not alone.
Warmth from Vexana's star stops her body fading.
Guinevere says she made the one she gave Vexana with her own hands.
Guinevere wears a star at her collar; it dims as she fades.
Guinevere's star flickers and lights, and a second star answers far off.
The two stars flare together, gold and violet, and their light pierces the void.
Guinevere's star beeps and Vexana's answers; it is the pair's sound.
Both stars glow as the pair go into the fight.
Under the field both stars go dark.
For weeks Guinevere's lit star was her only proof that Vexana was out there.
When the field dies Guinevere's star lights again, and Vexana's shines through her sleeve.

ties.t: Guinevere says she made it.

facts.t: Vexana says she wore it into the corridor rather than keep it in the box.
It is a little pink-haired doll that hangs inside Vexana's sleeve beside the star; Guinevere had said 'Now you have me on yours.'
It hangs on a clip at Vexana's wrist beside her lit star.
Guinevere wears it on her cracked arm guard and touches it when she sees Vexana's keychain.
It jumps on its clip when Guinevere punches an Ender's core.
Vexana says she kept everything from her days with Guinevere in it: ticket stubs, a paper fan, a doughnut napkin.
Vexana says the keychain was not in it; she wore that into the corridor.
Guinevere found it in Vexana's room the night no call came.

ties.t: It was in Vexana's room.

facts.t: Vexana says she kept ticket stubs from her outings with Guinevere in her box.

ties.t: They are kept in the box.

facts.t: Vexana says she kept a paper fan from her days with Guinevere in her box.

ties.t: It is kept in the box.

facts.t: Vexana says she even kept the napkin from a doughnut in her box.

ties.t: It is kept in the box.

facts.t: The night Guinevere waited at her father's office, a roll of Vexana's tape turned up on her jacket.
Her father turned pages until dusk and never reached for the paper Guinevere brought.
Two felt dolls stand on Vexana's desk with a card under them.

ties.t: They stand on her desk.

facts.t: Under the felt dolls on Vexana's desk, a card says 'Same place. Next year.' in her small square letters.

ties.t: It sits on her desk.

facts.t: Vexana once went very still over a star clip at a shop counter and said nothing.
They burn at her shoulders as she lands on the platform.
Two drones circle her with blazing yellow rings.
She gives them orders as left and right, and tells the right one to stop showing off.
The right one cracks an Ender across the head on its own.
Under the field their rings go out and they drop out of the sky.
One lies gray beside her, and her fingers find its ear; it is the right one.
They stay behind on the stones when she runs for the gap.
They are the first things to light again, rising out of the smoke.
They come up the cut ears up, and the right one knocks an Ender off the heap.
The right one bumps her cheek.
They take whatever comes high in the last fight.

ties.t: They fight at Guinevere's orders.

facts.t: Vexana's farewell came over Guinevere's open line into Fanny's ear.
That morning the word 'traitor' went down it.
Vexana has no comm, so Guinevere lends her the one from her own ear.
It still works under the field.
Lesley says comms hold while suits don't.
Its green light stays on on the deck.
Since the charge it has carried Guinevere's laugh.
Guinevere loses her earpiece, and the channel with it, in her fall.
She holds them low at the rail after her last arcs.
Their cyan edges brighten as her rig hums.
Under the field the cyan leaves their edges and they are plain steel.
She sweeps one back over her shoulder into an Ender's open chest.
When her rig catches, light runs down both blades and arcs jump off their edges.
It hums louder after the pair return; it went thin and quiet when 'traitor' went down the channel.
It roars at her hips as she comes down off the platforms.
Its cable catches a lamppost to swing her, and its thrusters kick her on.
It is still humming under the Citadel's storm.
Under the field it coughs once and goes silent, and the cable goes slack and dark.
It coughs and catches again when the field dies.
It hisses as it cools against her cheek.
The cyan cells on its stock fill one after another before she fires.
Under the field its cells go dark one by one, counting the wrong way, and it gives nothing.
It hangs dead on her back at the wall.
It wakes on her back, its cells lighting cyan from the bottom up.
It rests on Ruby's shoulder.
It is the one weapon still lit under the field.
Oro built it, and nothing in it runs on aspirant power, so the field found nothing in it to put out.
Fanny calls it the only charge left.
Ruby makes one cut with it into an Ender's core.

ties.t: Oro built it.

facts.t: It stands pink over the four of them on the platform.
Its pink light curves down around the wounded on every side.
Under the field it flickers and goes out.
It opens again over the wounded when the field dies.
Angela's body runs on her own cell, as it always has, so the field does not stop her.
Angela says 'Battery recharged!' when her shield comes back.

ties.t: It powers Angela's body.

facts.t: Under its dead coil the old action still slides back and locks by hand.
The day Chang'e gave it to her, Lesley thought it would still work in the dark.
It is a spring, a pin, a bolt and plain rounds.
Its round goes into the Ender's open core.
Chang'e built it for Lesley's rifle; under the field it goes cold.
It ran cooler than the old one since the dawn Lesley fitted it.
It wakes and comes up to the note Chang'e tuned it to.

ties.t: Chang'e built it.
It sits along the rifle's barrel.

facts.t: It draws the deck in thin teal lines; Chang'e built it at the old base before there were suits, and nothing in it runs on aspirant power.
It finds the climbing Ender first.
It shows the Ender's opening plates as one teal line, then a sliver.
It catches the lightning on the bell tower's roof.

ties.t: Chang'e built it.
It is Lesley's eye.

facts.t: Small crescents that float around Chang'e's chair drop and ring on the floor under the field.
When the field dies they lift one by one, white edged with pink, and turn around her again.

ties.t: They turn around Chang'e.

facts.t: Every suit's line on it turns and climbs after the pair return.
Thin lines run down its side, one for every suit in the city.
Its lines fall flat in the order the field reaches them, a speck of gold last.
Chang'e lays the new hum over the ship's outline on its screen.
When the field dies every flat line jumps at once, a gold one first.
A thin trace from the morning still runs at its bottom, still with no name.

ties.t: It stands on the command deck.

facts.t: A thin trace from the morning still runs at the bottom of Chang'e's screen and still has no name.
Vexana grounds it before answering Lesley's order.
It is an Ender's staff.
Under the field its orb gives no light.
Vexana holds it across her body like a pole.
Vexana gets it under an Ender's leg and heaves it down the heap.
Fanny thinks of it as an Ender's robe.
It hangs torn on Vexana.
It makes Fanny hesitate one beat before defending Vexana.
Selena watched Guinevere refuse to give Vexana up, robe and all.
Guinevere thinks Vexana wears the Enders' shape but is theirs.
Vexana sets Guinevere's left bow straight.
It has worn down by half, and Selena is making it last.
She takes it out, looks at it and tells it 'Not yet.'
Its stick stops moving in her mouth when Guinevere falls.
Guinevere knows the stick before she knows Selena's face.
Selena always lets them melt.
She bites this one and it cracks between her fangs.
Selena's hand closes on it in her pocket, still in its twist of paper.
She leaves it in her pocket.
Selena remembers a fruit drop in a twist of paper after the night of the mud; she made it last.
On the night of the mud a lamp swung down a dark street, its flame leaning in the glass, and the hot glass hung by Selena's cheek.
One of the rescue lamps in the wards would be Karina's.
Karina carries a lamp from door to door in the flooded wards.
Selena sits on the bell tower in her school uniform.
She still wears it when she stands up to change.
Its sleeves split as plate closes over her arms.
The small boy holds the back of Layla's uniform.
Guinevere had taken Selena's horns for part of a dark headband; the headband is gone now.
Lightning surges into her, her sleeves split, purple climbs her arms and dark plate edged in silver closes over her wrists.
Dark plate trimmed with silver closes up her ribs and throat, pale shards of armor stand off her shoulders and a long cloak runs from purple into blue.
Two small horns grow out of her blonde hair.
She has ears that come to points and hands that end in black claws.
She shows fangs when she smiles.
Selena calls it the real her.
Her full true form is plate of white, blue and gold with a large pale mane, four black-and-gold blades in the air and a blade of light along one arm.
It is the suit she once showed the class turning above her desk as 'Ender plating, my own design.'
She had never let all of it out before, and it fits.
Obsidia's weapon cracks its plates and purple wells at the hole.

ties.t: It is Selena's own shape.

facts.t: Four black-and-gold blades hang in the air around her, and a blade of crackling light runs along one arm.
She cuts the throne through at the base with the blade on her arm.
Her four blades swing in with every cut.
They tumble after her when she falls.
They come back and hang around her.
Selena read its top row out in class; every number in it was higher than the ones she sold.
She had called those numbers stale.
Under the field even the top row goes dark.
Every suit's line on Chang'e's board climbs after the pair return.
Under the field the suits fail while comms hold.
Chang'e's console shows a line for every suit in the city.
Small suits and big ones go dark alike.
Selena once showed the class a suit of her own design, made of Ender plating.
Selena thinks every suit at the Academy was built from Enders.
One giant wears a gray shoulder on a purple arm; Selena sold it to Vexana one night in the dead ground.
Selena sold her the plates because she wanted to see how it was done.

ties.t: A sold plate sits on one of the giants.

facts.t: It kneels cracked against a wall three streets west, and no light rises there.
Obsidia recalls a machine of Ender plates that stood in front of the body's beam; it had stayed dead under her hand in the hollow, but a human's belief lit it.

ties.t: Vexana looks to it after the battle.

facts.t: Chang'e names the Storm Citadel as the ship from it.
Fanny saw it as a shaking film in Joe's class.
In it every machine under the Citadel's storm died.
Lesley says the field is not the storm from the records.
Vexana recalls it saying that in the black hole the body goes first.
Vexana read the page twice in the library.
Vexana recalls it saying the consciousness of the Aspirants would bloom inside the black hole and pierce the void, reconnecting with the human world.
Guinevere remembers Vexana saying that Aspirant power piercing the black hole lets them return.
Chang'e says it was only a guess.
Lesley says it is now tested and tells her to log it.

ties.t: Chang'e wrote it.

facts.t: Chang'e says 'You owe me a pudding.'
Since the founding a caramel cup has turned up outside the lab door after every long night, the spoon laid square across the lid, never a note.
Lesley answers 'Two.'

things.name: pink box with a teal ribbon

facts.t: It still stands on the top shelf of Layla's lab beside her trophy.

ties.t: It sits on the lab's top shelf.

facts.t: It stands on the top shelf of Layla's lab beside a pink box.

ties.t: It sits on the lab's top shelf.

facts.t: Fanny, Layla and a few soldiers drag a door and a shop sign across the street.
It is made of a door, a shop sign and a car tipped on its side, across the narrowest place, with one gap wide enough for one Ender at a time.
A dead Ender in front of the gap forces the rest to climb over it one at a time.
Four dead long-legged Enders make a heap in front of the gap.
Fanny built it the way suitless soldiers taught her.
The soldiers lay their rifles across the stack.
Its weak end, where the shop sign meets a house front, slides.

ties.t: It stands across the cut.

facts.t: Dozens of dark, quick ships pour out of the mouth around the Citadel, each with its own small sharp hum.
Their bellies open over the bay and Enders drop out by the hundred.
They are still dropping Enders on the district.
Over each of Obsidia's palms a small black sphere wakes, ringed with fire; laid against the throne, they send a new hum down the spine.

ties.t: Obsidia lays them against the throne.

facts.t: It glides out of the dark and settles under Obsidia's hand; she draws her claws down it and it goes still.
Obsidia talks to it.
It is long and silver-pink.
At the lift of one finger it lashes out across the hall; where it meets Selena's blade the hall flashes white.
It goes through Selena's side.
It fires bolt after bolt.
Its tip flares gold and fires once more, point-blank.

ties.t: It comes to Obsidia's hand.

facts.t: Chains of bone crawl up out of the floor behind Selena, joint after joint, each ending in a spike.
They coil round her ankle and waist, lift her off the floor and pin her arms.
The nearest point rests cold against her throat.
Selena tears the nearest point apart with her claws.
Her lightning breaks them to pieces.

ties.t: Obsidia raises them without looking.

facts.t: Gold fire breaks out of Obsidia and wraps her as her shape changes.

It is a taller figure of silver and gold plate with a crown of silver points, magenta light in its joints, and purple and yellow wings of energy wider than the storm, each with a dark eye ringed in gold.
It is the strongest thing Selena has ever seen.
Obsidia's voice does not change in it.

ties.t: It is Obsidia's changed shape.

facts.t: It climbs out of sight, bone over bone; the body grew it for Obsidia when she woke.
Under Obsidia's palm it is warm and hums.
The field sleeps in its bone.
When Obsidia closes her fingers on it, the whole ship wakes.
It is a column of joints lit violet from inside, and it hums.
Selena finds that the field is kept there.
Its hum quiets Selena's blood.
Selena could climb it and take Obsidia's place, as she once thought she would if she had to.
Cut through at the base, it falls into a heap of pale plates.
When it falls, the hum stops.
Selena calls it the chair as the Citadel bursts.

ties.t: It stands at the top of the hall's stairs.
The body grew it.

facts.t: It sleeps in the bone of the throne until Obsidia wakes it.
Its hum is deeper than the ship's own, felt in the chest before it is heard.
Under it rubble rises off the road and hangs in the air, turning.
It is a magenta sphere under the ship, its edge crawling with flickering squares, spreading over the roofs and streets.
It puts out Angela's shield.
It drains Layla's cannon.
It silences Fanny's rig and cable.
It kills Guinevere's drones and wings.
Comms still work under it, but suits do not.
Chang'e traces its hum to one long thing in the middle of the ship.
Selena feels it is made of what she is made of.
It passes through Selena bone by bone and finds nothing to take.
Selena thinks it was built from the numbers she sold, as a floor, plus a margin.
It finds nothing to put out in Ruby's scythe, which uses no aspirant power.
It does not stop Angela's body, which runs on her own cell.
Selena realizes it is kept in the throne.
When the throne is cut its hum stops, the magenta leaves the air and the hanging slabs fall.
Chang'e reads it as dead at its source.

ties.t: It sleeps in the throne's bone.
Obsidia wakes it.

facts.t: The red heart burns far along it.
It cannot feed the storm and the field at once.
A new hum runs down it into every block.
It is one long thing running through the ship; every block hangs off it.
It reads alive, like an Ender's insides, and Chang'e calls it a spine.
Nothing they have can hit it from the deck.
After the throne is cut it reads nothing.
Chang'e thinks somebody cut it.

ties.t: It runs through the whole ship.

facts.t: It burns brighter far along the spine as the ship wakes.
A red-orange heart burns deep in the middle of the ship.

ties.t: It burns in the middle of the ship.

facts.t: It winds in close around the hull as the ship wakes.
Its black cloud pours from the mouth and spreads low across the water.
It rolls out across the bay ahead of the ship.
The cloud sinks and the Citadel comes down out of it over the Academy.
It strikes at nothing, because the spine cannot feed it and the field at once.
Selena's route goes straight up through it.
It thins to rags, and without it the ship sinks.
It comes apart beneath Selena and Obsidia.

ties.t: It surrounds the ship.

facts.t: When Obsidia closes her fingers on the throne, the ship wakes block by block and its prow tips toward the star of sky.
It begins to move.
It is a ship with a whole city hanging from it upside down, black towers pointing down with edges cut to blades, a red-orange heart burning in its middle.
Enders leap from its lowest towers.
Chang'e names it as the ship from the oldest record.
It clears the mouth and turns inland toward the Academy.
It fills the sky over the Academy from the hill to the water.
In the old record every machine under its storm died.
It hangs over the Academy close enough to count its towers.
Its black blocks hang upside down with sharp edges, gray Enders standing in their open holds; the blocks move aside along Obsidia's call.
When Selena cuts the throne, explosions go off deep inside and it tilts as if to fall.
Fire runs along its black ribs and burning pieces blow toward the bay.
Vexana once walked its hanging streets.
As its storm thins it sinks, and the wind carries it back out over the bay.
It drifts into the mouth, the black point takes it, and it breaks apart and blows up inside.
None of it falls on the city.

ties.t: It wakes and moves at Obsidia's grip.

facts.t: Obsidia stands at the top of its steps, deep among the hanging blocks.
Selena enters through a gap between two black ribs.
It is dark and very large, with wide stairs running up into violet light.
Its ribs burn and smoke pours between them; blasts make the whole hall drop a step.
Its stairs lean like a roof as the ship tilts.
Obsidia's shot throws Selena out through a gap between two ribs.

ties.t: It lies deep in the Citadel.

facts.t: On it Obsidia had told the girl beside her that nothing made of matter ever comes back out.
It tips toward the star of sky as the ship wakes.

ties.t: It is the front of the ship.

facts.t: Inside it there is no up, no down and no sound.
Inside it speaking and thinking feel the same.
Vexana and Guinevere were swept into it.
Vexana calls it an empty, dark void.
It sits at the middle of the Singularity.
No reading had ever come back out of one before the two signals.
Obsidia had said nothing made of matter ever comes back out.
Two lights came back out of it, and the body gave way before them.
It takes the wrecked Citadel, which breaks apart and blows up inside.

ties.t: It sits at the Singularity's middle.

facts.t: It burns over the bay with the Mother Matrix at its edge and the black point at its middle.
It flares white before the two lights come out.
After the Matrix goes back, the mouth burns empty.
Black cloud still pours from it.
From the Citadel it looks like a star of human sky.
Its rim, magenta all morning, burns red, and its four points drag wider as the sky tears.
The Citadel comes through it wrapped in its own storm.
It still hangs open with the Matrix's signature faint behind its light.
All day the wind blew toward it.
Light tears across it from rim to rim when the Citadel blows up inside.
Vexana says it is torn, not closed.
Cracks of light split its red face and the whole mouth flickers.
On the platform Vexana's hand had been burned raw.
Fanny stands at the platform's rail after the charge.
Below its broken edge lies rubble where the giants lay.
The frontline turns there to meet the Citadel's Enders.
Fanny comes down off them into the district.
The Singularity burns over it.
Enders drop over it from the small ships.
Rain hisses on it when the street goes quiet.
The wind carries the burning Citadel back out over it.
Enders come down along it.
Fanny takes it at roof height.
For a moment it is nearly clear.
Its lamps still burn after the field.
Slabs hang turning in the air over it.
The slabs fall when the hum stops.
Vexana's giants hold it in the last fight.
It is a narrow street that climbs from the water to the shelters.
The field's edge reaches its top first.
Guinevere falls at its mouth.
Lesley orders the frontline back into it to hold one street.
In one narrow street with the shelters at its back, people on foot can hold.
Fanny builds the wall where its houses stand closest.
It is too narrow for four long-legged Enders, whose legs tangle at its mouth.
They hold it for minutes.
They fight on at its mouth.
It runs below the hill, from the bay road up to the hall, with full shelters at the frontline's back.
Lesley judges that a powerless line spread over the district would be a dead line.
Gold and cyan come back into its streets.
The Citadel's cloud spreads over it.
The ship fills the sky from the hill to the water.
The field's edge rolls down it toward the water.
It marks the top of the frontline's ground.
The field's sphere takes in its roofs first.
The ship's underside glows over it.
They are full and stand at the frontline's back.
They stand at the top of the bay road cut.
A small boy cries in a shelter doorway.
The wounded lie along the house fronts below them.
Vexana says her father told her to stay back there; she did not, so he came back for her.
Vexana says she shouted 'Stay back!' at Guinevere in it.
Vexana says she wore the keychain into it.
Guinevere thinks of it as the place where Vexana took the claw for her.
Under it Vexana told Guinevere only that her father liked the stars.
Vexana read the page of Chang'e's paper there twice.
Guinevere followed the ringing of Vexana's phone into it and found the box.
Her desk holds two felt dolls and a card.
Guinevere waited outside it all day.
Through the gap in its door her father turned pages until dusk.
Hester brought her father's message to Guinevere at the gate.
Vexana says Guinevere took her there.
Vexana says Guinevere took her to the girls' house.
Guinevere says she took Vexana to all the best girl hangout spots.
That morning the pair's sound made Guinevere cry there.
There Guinevere told Layla, 'Her name is Vexana.'
There Layla called Vexana a traitor to Guinevere's face.

things.name: the lot at the dome's foot

facts.t: Soldiers held rifles up at two girls off a black ship, with Vexana in that line beside Guinevere, her staff ready.
Fanny told the soldiers she had watched the two girls fight a giant for the city and would answer for them.
A sergeant asked her 'On whose word?'
Fanny answered 'Mine.'
Enders land on towers almost at its landward edge.
Fanny and Layla first fought back to back on the sand outside it.
There Fanny first fought back to back with Layla and told her which side was hers.
Selena sold Vexana a gray shoulder plate there one night.
Selena watches the battle from its tiles.
Selena sits at its very edge with her legs over the air.
It looks small under the Citadel.
Lightning crawls over its roof, then climbs up off the tiles.
It stands right under the glowing ship.
Selena steps off it.
It stands high and clear over the Academy's roofs and is where Selena always does her thinking.
From the Citadel it looks the size of a hand.
After the throne is cut its roof is empty.

ties.t: It stands over the Academy's roofs.

facts.t: Lesley stands there behind Chang'e's chair at the console.
Through its long window the Citadel hangs over the Academy.
Its window glass buzzes in its frame when the floor hums.
It sits in a tower inside the field.
An Ender bursts its window glass and hauls itself in.
The empty window frame lets in the wind.
Rain still comes in through the empty frame.
Chang'e built Lesley's machine eye there, before there were any suits.
Lesley once thought her vow there, across the water, with the rifle in her hands.
On the night the Enders came back, Chang'e looked straight up at it from the avenue, knowing which window it was.
Since the founding a caramel pudding cup has turned up outside its door after every long night.
A pink box with a teal ribbon stands on its top shelf beside a trophy.
Layla once spied on Fanny's alley thing from it.
Every night there Guinevere trained fists first, then drones.
There a boy called Selena dangerous, and she answered 'One day, when the haze clears...'
Selena read out the table of suits there.
Selena sat in its front row, came in late with her guardian's note and slept on her arms.
Selena showed the class her suit turning above her desk.
It lies under one of the Academy's roofs.
Selena follows faults through circuits on it.
On it Selena once thought she would break the field herself if anyone pointed it at the Academy.
Its roofs still smoke from the first wave when the Citadel's Enders land.
Enders land in the wards past the old market, on streets Selena raced through on storm nights.
Rescue lamps move through its flooded streets.
Its lamps stop moving and point up at the lightning.
Karina carries a lamp from door to door there.
Enders land in the wards past it.
On the night of the mud Selena stood barefoot in it.
A lamp swung down it toward her.
Oro built Ruby's scythe.
On Oro every post was chosen for Ruby, inside a golden birdcage.
There Ruby's rage came once, with Angela lying still behind her.
There it took Angela's shout to bring Ruby back.
There Angela asked how to stop it, and Ruby had no answer.
On the day of the breach Joe knelt there over a girl with a pink rabbit before a slab came down on him.
Obsidia remembers Selena curled like a sad girl at the end of a row in the nest.
Obsidia once kept her post at its edge among drifting stones, a red drain burning in its middle, while a world below went dark.
On none of them had anything wounded the Will's body.
After the first came cities under orange fire, more than Obsidia kept count of.
Obsidia recalls that a machine of Ender plates stayed dead under her own hand in the hollow, until a human's belief lit it.
Two girls came off a black ship at the lot by the dome's foot, and soldiers raised their rifles at them.
The two lights come down at the Matrix's chest from the city's side.
Fanny watched Vexana fly at the Matrix's chest for the city.
Nothing of the burning Citadel falls on the city.
Selena sees the city through the breaking cloud.
Guinevere came to it to prove herself and earned top marks.
Selena sits on a tower over it.
The Citadel turns toward it.
The Citadel fills the sky over it.
The field hangs over it.
Selena tells the signal she prefers life at the Academy.
Selena thinks every suit at it was built from Enders.
Selena tells Obsidia she still prefers life at the academy.
Guinevere remembers Vexana saying that when the Aspirant's power pierces the black hole, they can return to the human world.
Nothing in Lesley's machine eye runs on it, so it keeps working under the field.
Under the field Guinevere reaches for her power and nothing comes.
Nothing in Ruby's scythe runs on it, so the field finds nothing to put out.
Guinevere says, 'We have only one Aspirant spirit.'
Fanny says, 'A strong Aspirant spirit becomes the blade that cuts through despair.'
Guinevere remembers that even Fanny said it, and her star lights.
Fanny said it with her blades raised at Vexana.
Guinevere tells Fanny she held on to it inside the black hole.
Vexana recalls Chang'e's paper saying it would bloom with brilliance inside the black hole and pierce the void back to the human world.

ties.t: It is the paper's idea.

facts.t: Vexana thinks 'Plan B' when warmth stops her body fading.
It went thin in Selena's cells while the Matrix reeled, then came back hotter and nearer.
The pulse tells Obsidia where Selena is.
Obsidia holds back the last call.
The pull in Selena's cells comes from just behind the red mouth.
Inside the ship it spreads out among the blocks, and Selena loses it.
It stops asking; everything Ender in Selena's blood leans up toward the ship.
All day it says one thing to Selena: come back.
Since the street it runs through the blocks to one place deep inside the ship.
Its road runs straight back to its sender, and nobody closed it.
Obsidia sends the last call, which carries where she stands.
It stops burning when Selena reaches the throne hall.
Obsidia says it to Selena's face: 'Come back, my puppet.'

ties.t: Obsidia sends it.

facts.t: It comes up through the tiles into Selena's bones before she sees anything.
Every Ender carries a small piece of it; the Citadel carries the whole.
It is the hum Selena heard on the night of the mud.
Selena's bones call it home.
Each small ship hums a small sharp note under the deep one.
In the throne hall the ship's note and the field's lower note come from one place.
Selena thinks of Vexana as another pawn getting out of the game.
Obsidia calls Selena her pawn.
Obsidia says her finest creation has gone off-script.
Selena would rather live as Selena than remain someone else's pawn.
Obsidia greets Selena as 'my little doll.'
Asking what to destroy next is the line a good pawn would say.
Obsidia says the next thing to destroy is a pawn with no surprises left.
Selena says she will never be Obsidia's puppet again.
Obsidia calls her 'my puppet.'
Obsidia says destruction gives rise to new life, and that is the meaning of purification.
Obsidia says purification is not the end but where everything begins.
Selena says she does not care about it.
Obsidia says destruction is hers to command.
Obsidia tells Selena she does not understand the true power of Destruction.
Obsidia had always stood above destruction.
Obsidia says destruction and faith share the same origin.
From an Ender's arm lift to its chest split is always three; Layla timed it on the first ones.
She calls 'Three! Two! Now!' along the wall.
The soldiers fire on her count, and Fanny strikes on it.
She counts silently when back to back with Fanny.
Her cannon fires on her own count.
The wall stands across the narrowest place with one gap; nobody swings until an Ender does, then steel goes into the core.
Layla once spied on it from a dark gallery and then pretended she had never heard of it.
Layla sets her back against Fanny's, Fanny facing the heap and Layla the street.
Fanny first did it on the sand outside the dome.
In the cut nobody goes first.
Fanny's blade sweeps back over her shoulder where Layla's head had been.
They stand back to back on the heap with cannon and blades lit.
Guinevere punches into an Ender's core when its chest plates split.
A plain round goes only into an open core.
An Ender's core opens only when it strikes.
The core burns inside the open plates.
Joe taught that when an Ender strikes, that is how long you get.
When an Ender's chest opens, steel goes into the core.

ties.t: It sits inside an Ender's chest.

facts.t: Something comes up in Ruby when Angela is hurt.
When it came before, everything went quiet and hot, and she cut down everything in front of her.
It makes crying sound far away.
It never cared what it hit.
In the avenue it took Angela's shout to bring Ruby back.
This time Ruby holds it to one cut.

ties.t: It is Ruby's own rage.

facts.t: Chang'e asked for a place on the rotation, and Lesley always said No.
Selena joked about it in class; Karina still wants to see it.
That morning Selena's papers flew as she cried 'what about my graduation?!'
Selena thinks somebody down there still wants to see her graduate.
It still says Missing.
Lesley says to change it.

things.name: the charge at the Mother Matrix

facts.t: Before the strike Vexana said 'This is the final farewell' over Guinevere's open line.
Vexana and Guinevere were swept into the black hole.
Lesley watched the Matrix fire on Vexana, then watched Vexana charge it.
Two lights went into the Matrix's open chest together, and the black point took them.
Since the charge the open line has carried Guinevere's laugh.

things.name: the return from the black hole

facts.t: Warmth comes back into Guinevere, and her hands return.
The two stars flare together, gold and violet, and their light pierces the void.
Two lights, gold and violet, shoot out of the Singularity's center.
They rise over the Matrix's crown and come down at its chest together from the city's side.
The Mother Matrix goes slowly back into the star.
Layla counts twelve seconds.
Chang'e says no reading had ever come back out of a black hole before.
The body gives way before the two lights.
Vexana says her ignorance and foolishness led to her father's death, and that he died saving her.
She says he told her to stay back at the shelter door; she did not, so he came back for her.
The night no call came, Guinevere called Vexana's number out of habit and found the box in her room.
Every morning of the search Guinevere touched her star with two fingers.
For weeks the lit star was her only proof Vexana was alive.
Vexana says Guinevere took her to see the summer fireworks.
Guinevere counts it among the things friends should share.
Obsidia had planned to go in herself once the mouth was clear if the body failed.
Obsidia opens it with 'Let us begin the final purge.'
Enders drop over the bay by the hundred.
They come down on the waterfront, the bay road, the wards and inland towers near the dome's edge.
The landings stop and the frontline pushes them back toward the water.
The Storm Citadel comes down over the Academy.
Lesley thinks of it as the second front.
The waterfront roofs still smoke from it.
Rescue lamps move through the wards it hit.

things.name: defense of the bay road cut

facts.t: Lesley orders the powerless frontline to pull back into the cut and hold it.
Fanny builds the wall with one gap.
They hold the street for minutes.
Soldiers and Aspirants strike on Layla's count.
After the field dies they fight on, giants on the road, drones high, cannon and blades from the heap.
The Enders keep coming up out of the water.

things.name: the duel in the throne hall

facts.t: Selena's face makes a declaration of war on her maker.
Obsidia keeps Selena at her weapon's length and drives her up the stairs.
Selena cuts the throne instead of taking it.
From the street, two lights are seen meeting and breaking apart in the burning hull.
Vexana does not know who is winning.
The two lights leave the hull and climb into the sky over the bay.
Selena cuts Obsidia's cheek.
Obsidia's weapon goes through Selena's side.
Selena is blasted out of the Citadel and Obsidia follows.
The stretch ends with Selena charging Obsidia's open arms; the outcome is not told.
After Selena cuts the throne, explosions go off deep in the ship and it tilts.
Its storm thins, it sinks, and the wind carries it back out over the bay.
It drifts into the mouth and blows up inside, and light tears across the portal.
Nothing of it comes down on the city.
From above, Selena sees it drawn into the dark and burst.
That night Selena stood barefoot in a dark street while the hum came down from a black cloud over the bay, with violet light moving in it.
Someone set her down asleep in the mud and went back up into the clouds.
It rained that night as it rains now.
A woman with a lamp knelt in the mud and gathered her up.
Selena's arms went round the woman's neck on their own.
Days after the night of the mud, at a window running with rain, she gave herself a name, and Karina said 'Selena it is.'
Selena is a name she chose for herself.
In Obsidia's mouth the name sounds owned.
Since that night Lesley carried the words of her vow to keep Chang'e safe.

things.name: the night the Enders came back

facts.t: That night on the avenue Chang'e turned and looked straight up at Lesley's window.
Layla thinks Fanny's idea of covering came from it.
On its day a slab came down on Joe on the avenue.
Since the founding a caramel pudding cup has turned up outside Chang'e's lab door after every long night.
